review: Life sized lizardmen. I've been a Warhammer fan for 15 years and this is a dream come true. Wish they made a VR Warhammer game! For now it's just a show.

So thought this could be a good show in VR, hopefully about VR, or even about games, but it's a scam.  They did one episode about a story game (non VR), and then disapeared.  "We'll be back in December", yep not back yet by, calling it slightly early, (1/27/17) February.  You guys can foo the bar off.

Think a interview type of TV show but in VR.

There's some movement and messing with objects but this is an interveiew so you are listening and watching mostly (40 minutes long).

Kickerstarter was a success so new eps this year.

Who'd ever want to watch in 2D again.
Very entertaining; loved the gimmick of throwing you into the game they're talking about. Can't wait for more episodes. Little disappointed that this wasn't the Will Smith I was expecting, though. :/
